svg.title: Shared prompt prefixes
svg.desc: Three prompts use 16-token blocks. The first two share instruction blocks S1 and S2 and Raft blocks R1 and R2. The third shares the instructions but uses Paxos blocks P1 to P3. Seven full blocks are stored instead of thirteen; each partial question block stays private.

g.text: S: instructions · R: Raft · P: Paxos · q: question
